claim: In the matching retail DLL, PlayerController_AI.SetAIAct (0x06004F9D) and its private leaf helper SetAIActCounter (0x06004FAC) are closed together as the core action-state setter used by FACT-0042 and the raw-act-21 path in FACT-0040. SetAIAct is an instance method with parameters act:AIActEnum and cnt:Int32 and an exact 102-byte body. When this.aiAct already equals act, it calls SetAIActCounter(cnt) and returns without changing aiActStep or dragOpponentCnt. Otherwise it stores aiAct=act, calls SetAIActCounter(cnt), stores aiActStep=0, increments dragOpponentCnt by one when the newly stored aiAct is raw 20, then stores dragOpponentCnt=0 when aiAct is neither raw 20 nor raw 19. SetAIActCounter is an exact 8-byte instance method with one Int32 parameter cnt and only stores aiActDuration=cnt then returns. FACT-0042 pins all seven priority-action wrappers as callers of SetAIAct with their exact raw action/time pairs, and FACT-0040 independently pins a direct SetAIAct(raw 17,768) call for raw priority act 21.

FACT-0042 pins the seven wrapper bodies calling token 0x06004F9D with raw action/time pairs: DownAtk (19,tm), RunUpDive_Stand (9,512), RunUpDive_Down (10,512), CornerDive (5,256), PriAct_RunAtk (16,tm), GoGrapple (1,tm), GoBackGrapple (3,tm).
FACT-0040 pins TryToDoPriorityAct IL+0x0204 group as direct SetAIAct token 0x06004F9D with raw action 17 and duration 768; exact call opcode occurs at IL+0x020C.

SetAIAct IL+0x0000..0x0065 reads/stores aiAct field 0x0400614B, calls SetAIActCounter token 0x06004FAC at IL+0x000E or IL+0x001D, stores aiActStep field 0x0400614D to zero on the changed-action path, increments dragOpponentCnt field 0x0400616B only for raw aiAct 20, and resets that counter when aiAct is neither 20 nor 19.
SetAIActCounter exact 8-byte body is ldarg.0; ldarg.1; stfld aiActDuration token 0x0400614C; ret.

limits: Raw AIActEnum values 19 and 20 are preserved numerically without gameplay labels.
This fact closes SetAIAct and SetAIActCounter bodies, not the later consumers of aiAct, aiActDuration, aiActStep, or dragOpponentCnt.
Many additional DLL callers of SetAIAct exist outside the already-canonical FACT-0040/0042 caller bridges and remain to be closed through their own caller seams.
CAP-R6-001 contains no standalone SetAIAct or SetAIActCounter PRE/POST event.
